subject: [PATCH v5 18/18] nfsd: use do_lookup_open() for non-creating open requests too.

reviews.author: NeilBrown
reviews.summary: Reviewer NeilBrown noted that the patch breaks the behavior where the server sends back NFS4ERR_DELAY on an OPEN while waiting for a DELEGRETURN, and suggested adding logic similar to nfsd_open_break_lease() into the vfs_lookup_open() path to fix it.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi,
 sorry for not getting to this sooner.
 I can see the problem.  To fix it we need to somehow get logic similar
 to nfsd_open_break_lease() into the vfs_lookup_open() path.  I think
 that'll be possible though not trivial.

 It is safe to drop just that patch for now.  I don't need it for the
 locking work that I am doing.  I think it is still good to have and I
 will try to rehabilitate it, but not in a hurry.

 I'm confident the rest of the series is not implicated in this problem
 so there is no need to drop the whole series.

Thanks,
NeilBrown

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS daemon to use do_lookup_open() for non-creating open requests, which is causing issues with the pynfs DELEG8 test by preventing the server from sending a reply until the delegation times out.
